summary: A modular firmware built on SLOOP, Felucca and other FM-1 projects: you choose which engines and features go in, build it in the browser, test it in a simulator and install it from there.
features: Four tracks: three synth and a 10-lane drum track
Browser builder plus ready-made flavours for synths or drums
64-step sequencer with p-locks, motion, conditions and note generators
Two insert effects per track, three returns and punch-in effects
Ableton Link and "JANK" Wi-Fi jamming; Bluetooth MIDI and audio
Optional SD card mode needs an added SD board
